boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations at Bala Cynwyd On City Avenue, a City Avenue retail destination beside Saint Joseph’s University’s Philadelphia campus.

cards.title: Outdoor gathering space
cards.subtitle: City Avenue corridor, Bala Cynwyd
cards.notes: Walk the City Avenue corridor to the center’s outdoor gathering and seating areas, then use the site plan to orient yourself among its named tenants.
cards.short_summary: A named retail destination with outdoor seating and a published tenant plan.
cards.evidence_claim: Federal Realty identifies Bala Cynwyd On City Avenue at 59 E City Avenue and publishes a site plan; City Ave District reports outdoor gathering and seating areas.
cards.source_title: Bala Cynwyd On City Avenue | Federal Realty Investment Trust
cards.access_notes: Use the published site plan to locate individual tenants; access and hours vary by tenant.

cards.entity_name: ACME Markets E City Ave & Conshohocken State Rd

cards.source_title: ACME Markets Grocery Delivery & Pickup — Bala Cynwyd
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists daily grocery hours and pickup service; purchases are optional.
